QuestInfo.name: Fantastic Show!
QuestInfo.0: Madame Ming mentioned a great show you shouldn't miss in Fantasy Theme World. Go find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Visit the Fantasy Crittertorium at #m223030210#. But first, find Oliver in #m223030200#.

0.0: In fact, have you visited the Fantasy Crittertorium yet? It's a wonderfully primal trek through the natural world! Won't you try it?

yes.0: You know what? It's on me! You just show up in #b#m223030200##k and talk to one our employees to get into the Fantasy Crittertorium. Have fun!

no.0: Are you sure? It really is a great show!

1.0: Ah, good to see you! I hope you're having a wonderful time in Fantasy Theme World! Are you here to see the Fantasy Crittertorium?

npc.0: Don't miss the Fantasy Crittertorium. You will regret it.
